summary: John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund filed an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) reporting June 2026 dividend declarations per share class, May 31, 2026 net asset values, and an update on its continuous public offering. Dividends range from $0.1887 for Class I (9.00% annualized yield) to N/A for other classes, payable July 24, 2026. The filing also discloses aggregate NAV of $473.5M, a $908.6M investment portfolio, $464.1M debt (0.98x leverage), and 19.0M Class I shares issued for $480.3M in the $2.0B offering. This is a routine dividend and NAV disclosure with no special situation triggering event.
